mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy becomes increasingly accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with UNRATE > 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls and rising unemployment rates indicate labor market contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown expectations intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals manufacturing slowdown and supply chain stress, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits indicates strong housing market activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as demand expansion accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly HOUST increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeds $500 billion, it signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances with RSAFS > 500000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures signal broad-based demand expansion, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as economic momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with HOUST and RSAFS both increasing, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250), the central bank's hawkish policy response leads to rising interest rates that compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 250, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
